tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Search IMI Daily's database of 300+ residence-by-investment, citizenship-by-investment, golden visa, digital nomad, retirement/independent-means, talent and descent programs worldwide. Filter by country, region, type, budget, income, stay requirement and time to citizenship. Returns compact rows with a url to each IMI Daily program page.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'EU golden visa real estate'

program_type.description: e.g. 'Citizenship by Investment', 'Residence by Investment' (golden visa), 'Digital Nomad Visa', 'Independent Means Visa', 'Active Investor Visa', 'Talent Visa', 'Citizenship by Descent'

max_annual_income_usd.description: Applicant's annual income in USD (returns programs whose income requirement is at or below this)

max_annual_stay_days.description: Maximum days per year the person can spend in the country

citizenship_path.description: Only programs that can lead to citizenship

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Full IMI Daily profile of one program: investment options and minimums, income and net-worth requirements, validity, stay rules, years to PR and citizenship, dual citizenship, visa-free access, settlement blocs, plus overview, how to qualify, benefits, citizenship timeline and legal basis (with source links).

program.description: Program name or slug, e.g. 'Greece Golden Visa' or 'portugal-golden-visa'

tools.name: compare_programs
tools.description: Side-by-side structured comparison of 2-8 programs (costs, requirements, timelines, visa-free access).

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Everything IMI Daily holds on a country: all paths to citizenship from the IMI Citizenship Catalog (naturalization, marriage, descent, investment, birth, exception, dual citizenship), settlement-bloc memberships, residence and citizenship programs, approved CBI agent lists, statistics datasets and tax regimes. For the United States it also summarizes the USCIS EB-5 regional center lists.

tools.name: get_settlement_blocs
tools.description: IMI Daily's Supranational Settlement Blocs (SSBs): treaties such as EU/EEA free movement, MERCOSUR, GCC, CARICOM/OECS, ECOWAS, the Common Travel Area and the Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement that give citizens of one member settlement rights in others. Includes member countries, tiers, conditions and whether CBI citizens are excluded.

country.description: Return only blocs this country belongs to

tools.name: find_approved_agents
tools.description: Government-authorized agents for the citizenship-by-investment programs of Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Vanuatu and Nauru, as published on the official government lists, with the date IMI Daily last checked each list. Use it to check whether a firm is an authorised agent.

query.description: Agent or firm name to check

tools.name: find_eb5_regional_centers
tools.description: Check the U.S. EB-5 regional centers designated by USCIS: the current approved list and the list of terminated centers with termination dates and whether the termination is under appeal. Search by center name or ID, filter by state or status. Data comes from the official USCIS lists, refreshed several times a day. Approval is a USCIS designation, not an endorsement of the center or its projects.

query.description: Regional center name or USCIS ID (e.g. 'RC2200000218' or 'ID1504052589')

state.description: U.S. state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'Texas' or 'TX'

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Official application, approval, pending, nationality, revenue and processing-time statistics compiled by IMI Daily (e.g. Greece golden visa, Grenada CBI, Italy investor visa, processing times across programs, industry structure). Call without a dataset to list datasets and headline findings.

dimension.description: Filter by dimension, e.g. a nationality

max_points.description: Cap on returned data points, default 600

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated log of changes IMI Daily detected in its datasets: program minimums, timelines and requirements, citizenship-catalog rules, approved-agent additions and removals, settlement blocs, and EB-5 regional center approvals and terminations.

dataset.description: programs, catalog, agents, tax_regimes, blocs or eb5_regional_centers

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: IMI Connect investment-migration industry events organized by IMI Daily.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Latest IMI Daily headlines with links (residence and citizenship by investment, golden visas, policy changes).

tools.name: about_imi_data
tools.description: Dataset list, freshness dates, record counts, industry overview, terms of use and how to cite IMI Daily.
